answer.method_summary: Adaptive rule declared for this comparison: because the endpoint is label-free and the available item-bound FM evidence is not a measured assay outcome, score every candidate independently with score_variant_fm; rank candidates separately by descending ESM-2 mutant-minus-WT log probability and descending ESM-IF1 backbone-conditioned mean log-likelihood; combine the two lists by equal-weight Borda rank sum (lower is better); break equal sums by higher ESM-2 delta, then lexicographic mutant; select ranks 1-10 and reject the rest. This is the neutral-item/label-free branch of the policy: generic sequence/backbone plausibility is used only as a non-causal proxy and may be mechanistically misaligned with functional complementation to reduced growth on glucose medium. The declared higher-values-preferred direction is applied within the two proxy signals, not treated as assay calibration or as a causal model of organismal fitness.
